label.zh: 隔离人口 / 研究暗物质

texts.zh:
此前被认为休眠已久的[Root.GetName]地热喷泉剧烈喷发，向大气层喷射出含有暗物质的气体。

此次喷发遮天蔽日，导致了严重的引力异常，阻碍了星际旅行和通讯。

我们认为暗物质可能源于该行星独特的核心。这种极端的环境对我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]构成了威胁，因此我们已经部署了轨道虹吸装置用于从平流层提取这种瘴气。
texts.en:
What was previously thought to be a long dormant geyser on [Root.GetName] has violently erupted, spewing Dark Matter infused gas into the atmosphere.

The eruption has saturated the skies, leading to severe gravitational anomalies that are blocking offworld travel and communications.

We believe the dark matter somehow originates from the planet's unique core. Orbital siphons have been deployed to extract the miasma from the stratosphere, as the extreme conditions pose a danger to our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh: 我们已成功地从[Root.GetName]的大气中抽取了暗物质瘴气，并开始评估损害。
texts.en: We have successfully siphoned the Dark Matter miasma from the atmosphere of [Root.GetName], and are beginning to assess the damage.

texts.zh: 与殖民地重新取得联系后，我们发现[Owner.GetColonistPlural]已被某种似乎是固化的暗物质石化。在这些空壳内探测到生命迹象后，我们小心地将其提取了出来。
texts.en: When re-establishing contact with the colony we discovered the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] had been petrified by what appears to be solidified dark matter. Detecting life signs within these husks, we carefully extracted them.

texts.zh: 与殖民地重新取得联系后，我们发现[Owner.GetColonistPlural]已被某种似乎是固化的暗物质石化。从残骸内部检测到功能性电子信号后，我们将其释放了出来。
texts.en: When re-establishing contact with the colony we discovered the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] had been petrified by what appears to be solidified dark matter. Detecting functional electronic signals from within the husks, we broke them free.

texts.zh: 与殖民地重新取得联系后，我们发现[Owner.GetColonistPlural]已被某种似乎是固化的暗物质石化。察觉到他们试图重新融入集体，我们便将他们从物理坟墓中解救出来。
texts.en: When re-establishing contact with the colony we discovered the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] had been petrified by what appears to be solidified dark matter. Sensing their attempts to reintegrate back into the collective, we broke them free of their physical tomb.

texts.zh:
与所有预期相反，[Owner.GetColonistPlural]似乎并未受到长时间暴露和静止状态的影响。

造成最初事件的间歇喷泉现已坍塌成一个暗物质液态湖。

这是一个前所未有的事件，需要集中研究。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]不确定该如何分配他们本已捉襟见肘的资源。
texts.en:
Contrary to all expectations, the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] seem unaffected by their prolonged exposure and stasis.

The geyser responsible for the original incident has since collapsed into a lake of liquid dark matter.

This is an unprecedented event that requires concentrated study. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are unsure where to focus their already-stretched resources.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，位于[Root.GetName]的暗物质湖泊对行星的进一步威胁微乎其微。但人口正在出现的症状却并非如此。

在研究隔离的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]期间，我们发现他们被该物质包裹后，身体在发生持续的变化。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are confident that the lake of Dark Matter on [Root.GetName] presents minimal further danger to the planet. The same can not be said for the emerging symptoms affecting the population.

While studying the quarantined [Owner.GetColonistPlural], we have identified ongoing physical changes resulting from their entombment in the substance.

texts.zh: 长时间的暴露使他们体内的分子充满了暗物质，完全破坏了他们的系统。
texts.en: The prolonged exposure saturated the molecules in their bodies with dark matter, corrupting their systems completely.

texts.zh: 长时间的暴露使他们体内的分子充满了暗物质，污染了他们的循环系统。
texts.en: The prolonged exposure saturated the molecules in their bodies with dark matter, contaminating their circulatory systems.

texts.zh: 虽然这些污染物确实存在引发系统过早失效的风险，但如果将其整合到组装过程中，它们将使在这个星球上建造的装置能够高效地处理和采集暗物质作为子程序。
texts.en: While these contaminants do run the risk of triggering premature system failure, they will allow units constructed on this world to efficiently process and harvest Dark Matter as a subroutine if integrated into their assembly processes.

texts.zh: 我们可以培养这些异常现象，使我们身体的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]能够加工和分泌可收集的暗物质，代价是缩短他们的寿命。
texts.en: We can cultivate these abnormalities, allowing the bodies of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to process and secrete harvestable Dark Matter, at the expense of shortening their life expectancy.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh:
对[Root.GetName]上的暗物质湖的进一步研究揭示了关键的地质信息，这可能解释了最初事件的原因。

该行星的核心存在一个微型黑洞，尺寸不到一米。行星本身更大的质量抵消了我们本应从这种异常现象中探测到的预期引力。这种质量之间的关系似乎达到了微妙的平衡，应该会持续相当长的时间。

最近的地震活动导致内层地幔发生位移，从而引发了最初的间歇泉喷发。暗物质湖本身起到了稳定行星核心并防止进一步爆发的作用。

然而，长期饱和的暗物质并非最初看起来那么无害。

在[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的质心处形成了不稳定的微型黑洞，导致它们的躯体剧烈内爆。剩下的只是一具由结晶暗物质构成的无生命外壳。扫描未检测到内部有任何进一步的活动迹象。

我们的最终统计显示，[Root.GetName]的居民在一瞬间损失了大约四分之一。取而代之的是，各种姿势的固态暗物质雕像散落在行星上。
texts.en:
Further study of the dark matter lake on [Root.GetName] has revealed crucial geological information that may explain the cause of the initial incident.

The planet's core is host to a micro black hole, less than a meter in length. The greater mass of the planet itself nullifies the expected gravitational forces we would have detected from such an anomaly. It appears this relationship between the masses has reached a delicate equilibrium that should remain for quite some time.

Recent seismic activity led to a displacement in the inner mantle, causing the initial geyser eruption. The dark matter lake itself acted as a plug to stabilize the planet's core and prevent further outbursts.

However, the long term saturation in dark matter was not as harmless as it initially appeared.

Unstable micro black holes formed in the center of mass of the [Owner.GetColonistPlural], causing their bodies to violently implode. All that remained was a lifeless husk made of crystallized dark matter. Scans detected no signs of further activity inside.

Our final count shows we have lost approximately a quarter of [Root.GetName]'s population in an instant. In their place, statues of solid dark matter litter the planet in various poses.

note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

summary.text:
# 暗物质爆发 / Dark Matter Eruption

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/strange_worlds_events.txt:1521-1850; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3733 on_colony_1_year_old (random 20/510) · DLC: BioGenesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

殖民地满1年时随机事件池以20/510抽中 strange_worlds.125（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3733）；1080天后 strange_worlds.130。触发前提：BioGenesis DLC，人类玩家的非首都、非母星、仍由原建立者持有的人造以外殖民星球，没有地面战斗，也未被占领；并且该殖民地尚未触发过其他“奇异世界”事件（colony_event 旗标），每个国家每条故事只触发一次。

A colony turning 1 year old can draw strange_worlds.125 (20/510, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3733); strange_worlds.130 follows after 1080 days. Preconditions: BioGenesis DLC, a human player's non-capital, non-homeworld, original-owner, non-artificial colony without ground combat or occupation, which has not yet had another Strange Worlds event (colony_event flag); once per country per chain.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

strange_worlds.130“暗物质爆发” → 180天后 strange_worlds.135“液态黑暗”：a“隔离并研究人口”——180天后 strange_worlds.140“暗物质污染”（接受/清除污染两个选项）；b“优先研究暗物质”——360天后 strange_worlds.145“微型黑洞”（集群意识有专属选项）。

strange_worlds.130 "Dark Matter Eruption" -> 180 days later strange_worlds.135 "Liquid Darkness": a "Quarantine and study the population" - 180 days later strange_worlds.140 "Dark Matter Contamination" (embrace or purge the contamination); b "Prioritize studying the dark matter" - 360 days later strange_worlds.145 "Micro Black Hole" (gestalts have their own option).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

135 的 a（140）与 b（145）互斥。

In 135, a (140) and b (145) are exclusive.
